name: Distanciamiento a deslindes
description: Minimum horizontal distance from the exterior face of the building to each property boundary. The required distance depends on building height and whether the facade has openings (windows, doors) or is a solid wall.

min_distance_con_vano_m.description: Minimum setback distance for facades with openings (con vano), in meters. Calculated as approximately h/4 for Zone EA12 Providencia (42 m height).

min_distance_sin_vano_m.description: Minimum setback distance for solid facades without openings (sin vano), in meters. Calculated as approximately h/8 for Zone EA12 Providencia (42 m height).

messages.green: Setback distance ({measured} m) exceeds the minimum required ({limit} m) on {boundary_name}
messages.yellow: Setback distance ({measured} m) complies but is close to the minimum ({limit} m) on {boundary_name}. Verify tolerances.
messages.red: Setback distance ({measured} m) is less than the minimum required ({limit} m) on {boundary_name}
